intro: The main Hellfire build is the one the rest of this planner follows. These are the PvP preset most Global Sorcerers run and two PvE presets they swap to, one for trash packs and one for hard bosses. None of the sources plays a frost damage build on bosses: on Global the ice skills show up as the farming preset.
crosscheck: Every source we checked agrees with the planner's core: Element Enhancement, Delayed Explosion, Fire Wall and Cold Storm as Stigmas, Hellfire charged by hand on its own key, and Hellfire, Firestorm, Bittercold Wind, Blaze, Wish of Concentration and Flame Arrow as the skills that get points first. Aion2Vault counts that Stigma set on 70% of public Global builds with four Stigmas, and aion2-guides.info (EUTOPIA's build), Metaroad, GamerBlurb, GamesFuze and Games.gg list the same four. There are three differences. First, the planner raises Ice Chain, Frost and Frost Burst to 10 for bosses. EUTOPIA and shr1kn leave Ice Chain low and take Frost and Frost Burst off the bar in the endgame (aion2-guides.info, Aion2Vault), and GamesFuze says they fall off. aLuckyRO and Metaroad still level Ice Chain. Second, on passives, Metaroad ranks Grace of Enhancement second after Robe of Flame. EUTOPIA keeps Robe of Cold high and Cold Snap low, while the planner's last row leans to Cold Snap. Third, on Hellfire's Specialty, Metaroad takes Changes to mobile skill and −15s cooldown over the Block and Evasion pick the planner uses. aion2-guides.info adds that EUTOPIA's highest damage came from stacked hotbar lines pressed by hand, not the macro, but every source keeps Hellfire out of the macro.

builds.name: PvP Control Burst
builds.role: Control caster for arena and Abyss
builds.summary: A second skill preset that keeps only Element Enhancement from the PvE Stigmas. The other three are a damage-reduction buff, an immunity and a Seal. You lock a player down with Soul Freeze, Bittercold Wind and Frost, then release a full Hellfire while they can't move. You have no dash, so the defensive Stigmas and two crowd-control breaks (Defiance and Remove Hibernation) keep you alive.
builds.when: 1v1 and small arena fights, and Abyss skirmishes. In large Abyss groups, some sources put Fire Wall and Cold Storm back in (see Where sources disagree).
builds.popularity: Aion2Vault counts 78 of 763 public Global Sorcerer builds named for PvP. 38 of those are shr1kn's four PvP builds or copies of them, and all of them run this Stigma bar. Hibernation is on 40 of 46 PvP builds and Soul Freeze on 34. GamerBlurb, Games.gg, Metaroad and Aion 2 Maps all publish a PvP Stigma bar built on Element Enhancement plus defensive Stigmas.
builds.vsMain: Swaps Fire Wall, Delayed Explosion and Cold Storm for Arctic Armor, Hibernation and Soul Freeze. Moves the points from Flame Scattershot, Grace of Enhancement, Vitality Evaporation and Cold Snap into Revitalization Contract, Grace of Resistance, Absorb Essence and Robe of Cold. Changes the Specialties to control, anti-heal and HP-absorb picks.

skills.note: 378 used, 5 spare. No source publishes a full PvP point order. This is the main build's spend with the swaps above. Leave Flame Scattershot, Cold Snap, Grace of Enhancement and Vitality Evaporation at 1

specialties.picks: Reset [Frost Burst] cooldown on landing Frost. From skill level 12, add +25% PC target Frost Chance, the only pick that names players (25 of 35 PvP builds take it). Frost's board nodes on the PvP route take it to 12.
-60% Incoming Heal for 5s on hit, in place of the MP or Skill Speed pick, against targets with a healer behind them. Keep -2s [Hellfire] cooldown per fireball.
Pull effect, which pulls players into the root, plus Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit.
Absorbs 7% HP, plus Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit.
Absorbs 3% HP in place of Delayed Damage, plus Multi-Hit on hit.
30% chance to inflict Frost for 3s on landing [Winter's Shackles], or keep the +20% PvE and +10% PvP Damage Boost pick.
+30% Skill Speed and Changes to mobile skill, so you aren't rooted while you charge it.
+20% Skill Speed (30 of 35 PvP builds), plus -1s [Winter's Shackles] cooldown on hit at 12.
Restores 20% HP on using [Defiance], or Adds [Curse: Old Tree] Chain Skill (10 of 17 PvP builds with Defiance on the bar). +2s Tenacity duration at 12.

stigmas.name: Element Enhancement
stigmas.why: Damage buff before your burst. At 5 it adds +200 Accuracy, which PvP needs. shr1kn raises it first.

stigmas.name: Arctic Armor
stigmas.why: +10% PvP Damage Tolerance for a short window, and +20% Impact-type Resist at 5. Use it at about half HP or just before their burst. Korean players raise it to 20 before anything else.

stigmas.name: Hibernation
stigmas.why: 5 s immune to damage and status effects. Remove Hibernation restores 20% HP, frees you from Stun, Knockdown, Airborne and Grab, and moves you back. Your second CC break.

stigmas.name: Soul Freeze
stigmas.why: 75% chance to Seal one target for 5 s, plus a Root chance from 5. Your lock for Hellfire. Swap: Steel Barrier when you are the one being focused, or Curse: Tree to take one player out of a group fight.

builds.daevanion: Azphel, the PvP board, uses its own crystals: 36 from Ereshkigal's Monolith in Season 1 and 110 from the Abyss Shop. Take the PvP Damage Boost and PvP Damage Tolerance core first, then the Status Effect nodes. shr1kn's boards end with all eight Status Effect Chance nodes. On the PvE boards, the PvP route on aion2-guides.info adds Frost's nodes on top of Firestorm and Winter's Shackles.
builds.gear: Abyssal Manastones with PvP lines. Fierce Battle Amulet (PvP Damage Boost) in place of the Revelation Amulet. Status Effect Resist on every armour piece. The Saint of Ereshkigal title. Brawler Wings or Talisra Wings. Keep one Genus preset for PvP, because PvE and boss lines do nothing against players. Stat order: Accuracy, then PvP damage, then HP and PvP Damage Tolerance, then Status Effect Resist. Korean guides say to reach about 2,500 Accuracy with PvP Accuracy included (KR numbers).
play: Put this in a second skill preset. Each preset keeps its own skill and Stigma levels.
Control first: Soul Freeze, Bittercold Wind's root and Frost. Then Element Enhancement and a full Hellfire on a target that's sealed, rooted or frozen. Never charge Hellfire in the open.
Make them use their Defiance before your best control. Defiance doesn't remove Root, Slow, Seal or Taunt.
Arctic Armor at about 50% HP or when you expect a burst. Hibernation below about 20%, or when an Assassin opens from Stealth.
Wait out Gladiator's Tenaciousness and Cleric's Salvation before you fire Hellfire.

shr1kn's PvP macro: Winter's Shackles; Bittercold Wind → Soul Freeze → Frost → Firestorm; Frost Burst → Blaze; Ice Chain. Hold it with Flame Arrow on the other mouse button. Hellfire, Arctic Armor and Hibernation stay off the macro.
Settings: target scanning ranks hostile players first, show the distance to your target and stay just under 20 m, and turn off running to the target when you press a skill.
pros: Two CC breaks, where most classes have one
20 m range and four ways to lock a target
Anti-heal on Firestorm punishes a healer's target
cons: No dash, and Hellfire roots you while you charge it unless you take the mobile pick
Frost and Seal are chance-based, so a fight can turn on a missed proc
Buff strippers (Assassin, Spiritmaster) can remove Arctic Armor

builds.disagree: Every source keeps Element Enhancement, and all but the Korean thread keep Hibernation. For the other two slots, shr1kn (Aion2Vault) runs Arctic Armor and Soul Freeze. Aion 2 Maps runs Steel Barrier and Arctic Armor. Games.gg and Metaroad run Steel Barrier and Soul Freeze, with Arctic Armor in place of Hibernation against steady pressure. GamerBlurb runs Arctic Armor and Curse: Tree. Korean players treat Element Enhancement, Steel Barrier and Arctic Armor as the base and argue over Hibernation. This build follows shr1kn because his bar is the most copied on Global and was updated after launch. Older copies of his builds still show Glacial Smite where Arctic Armor is now. For large Abyss fights, Games.gg keeps Fire Wall, Cold Storm and Steel Barrier, and Aion 2 Maps notes Fire Wall for group fights (Asian release).

builds.name: Ice AoE Farming
builds.role: Trash packs, open-world farming, solo levelling
builds.summary: A second PvE preset for packs. Bittercold Wind's Pull gathers and roots them, and Ice Chain is your repeatable hit with no cooldown: it reaches up to 4 targets and slows them 40%. Frost freezes, Frost Burst hits the frozen target and the ones around it, and Fire Wall, Cold Storm and Glacial Smite cover the pack. The ice skills the boss build leaves low do most of the work here.
builds.when: Dungeon trash, hideouts, open-world farming and questing. Switch back to the boss preset for bosses. You can't switch presets while a Stigma is on cooldown.
builds.popularity: Games.gg and Metaroad publish a separate farming or solo Stigma loadout. Aion 2 Maps has a trash preset, and aion2-guides.info lists Glacial Smite as the farming swap. Aion2Vault notes that several creators use Ice Chain only on packs, and Frost and Frost Burst are on about 9 in 10 public Sorcerer skill bars. No source runs a frost damage build on bosses.
builds.vsMain: Drops Delayed Explosion, a single-target window, for Glacial Smite (or Steel Barrier when soloing). Same 383-point spend as the main build, except Flame Scattershot's points (it only hits staggered targets) go into Absorb Essence. Puts the pack skills first and takes the MP, Pull and HP-absorb Specialties.

skills.note: Ice Chain, Cold Storm and Frost Burst slows set it off

stigmas.name: Element Enhancement
stigmas.why: Still the core buff. At 10 Robe of Flame counts ×1.5.

stigmas.name: Fire Wall
stigmas.why: Embers on up to 4 for 10 s, and more damage while they move through it.

stigmas.name: Cold Storm
stigmas.why: Slows and Frostbite on up to 4 for 7 s. Its slow sets off Cold Snap.

stigmas.name: Glacial Smite
stigmas.why: Instant hit on up to 4, with more damage the more it hits at 5. Good for short pulls that die before a field ticks. Steel Barrier instead when you solo and die too often.

builds.daevanion: Same PvE boards as the main build. Take Ice Chain's nodes on Nezekan and Zikel and Frost Burst's nodes earlier than the main route does, so Ice Chain passes 12 for its second pick.
builds.gear: The main build's gear. Watch Max MP and MP regen until pulls stop running you dry. Move Speed on boots and earrings helps between packs.
play: Pull with Bittercold Wind, then put Ice Chain in this preset's macro, usually as the last step.
Frost, then Frost Burst by hand. Frost resets Frost Burst, and Frost Burst heals you.
Drop Fire Wall and Cold Storm where the pack is rooted, and Glacial Smite on the next pull while they cool down.
Let go of the macro between pulls so Flame Arrow refills MP. Grace of Enhancement and Robe of Earth switch off when MP is low.
Use target mode, not action mode, so Flame Arrow keeps firing between skills.
pros: Ice Chain has no cooldown and hits up to 4
Roots, slows and freezes keep packs off you at 20 m
Frost Burst and Blaze HP absorbs let you solo without a healer
cons: MP-hungry: Ice Chain costs MP on every cast
Weaker than the boss preset on single targets
A second preset to keep levelled and switch to

builds.disagree: Every source keeps Element Enhancement and at least one field, but the fourth slot varies. Games.gg drops Delayed Explosion for Steel Barrier. Metaroad keeps Delayed Explosion and puts Glacial Smite in for Fire Wall or Cold Storm. GamerBlurb keeps the boss set with Glacial Smite as an option. This build drops the single-target Delayed Explosion, which suits packs, and takes Glacial Smite, the pick most sources name for farming. EUTOPIA (aion2-guides.info) leaves Ice Chain, Frost and Frost Burst out of his endgame bar entirely; that is a boss setup, not a pack setup.

builds.name: Hard Content: Stagger and Shield
builds.summary: The boss build with both ground fields swapped out. Steel Barrier gives you a shield, and Divine Burst deals 50 stagger damage in one cast, the most in the kit. Use it on bosses that kill you or that your group keeps failing to stagger, and on bosses that move too much for Fire Wall and Cold Storm to pay off.
builds.when: Nightmare, Transcendence and Ludra-type bosses, groups that miss stagger checks, and bosses you are still learning.
builds.popularity: The third most common four-Stigma set on public Global builds: Aion2Vault counts 17 builds with Element Enhancement, Delayed Explosion, Steel Barrier and Divine Burst. shr1kn's preset for stagger-heavy bosses is this bar. EUTOPIA swaps Cold Storm for Steel Barrier in Transcendence and Nightmare, and Metaroad, GamesFuze and aion2-guides.info list both swaps.
builds.vsMain: Steel Barrier and Divine Burst replace Fire Wall and Cold Storm. Robe of Cold and Revitalization Contract take the points from Cold Snap and Frost. Defiance goes to 10 earlier, and the HP-absorb and mobile Specialties go in.

skills.note: Earlier than in the main build: boss stuns
Restores 35% HP when you drop to 10%
378 used, 5 spare. The order is ours, from the main build and the sources' passive picks. Leave Frost, Cold Snap, Absorb Essence and Grace of Resistance at 1

specialties.picks: +30% Skill Speed, plus Changes to mobile skill while you learn the fight. Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as Multi-Hit once the boss stands still.
Absorbs 3% HP in place of Delayed Damage, plus Multi-Hit on hit.
Absorbs 7% HP, plus Changes to mobile skill.
Changes to mobile skill, plus Multi-Hit on hit at 12.
Restores 20% HP on using [Defiance].

stigmas.name: Element Enhancement
stigmas.why: Unchanged. At 10 Robe of Flame counts ×1.5.

stigmas.name: Delayed Explosion
stigmas.why: Unchanged. The target takes 15% more of your damage for 4 s. Press it before Hellfire. Restores 200 MP at 5.

stigmas.name: Steel Barrier
stigmas.why: A shield for up to 60 s with extra Damage Tolerance while it holds, plus +10% Move Speed at 5. Use it before the boss's big hit.

stigmas.name: Divine Burst
stigmas.why: 50 stagger damage at any level, and +20% Skill Speed at 5. Save it for when the stagger gauge opens. Never use it while the boss is invulnerable or already staggered.

builds.daevanion: The main build's route. When it reaches the defensive nodes at the end, take HP and Damage Tolerance before MP and resists.
builds.gear: The main build's gear. A PvE Damage Tolerance title (Metaroad names Dominator of Dimensions) is worth it while a boss keeps killing you.
play: Opener as in the main build: Element Enhancement, Delayed Explosion, then a full Hellfire. Put Steel Barrier up before you engage.
Hold Divine Burst and Flame Scattershot for the stagger gauge. Hellfire alone adds 20–35 stagger, so land it on cooldown.
Keep MP above 25% so Grace of Enhancement stays on. The Blaze and Frost Burst absorbs are your healing.
Once the group stops missing stagger checks, put Fire Wall back in for Divine Burst. That is EUTOPIA's and Metaroad's version.
pros: Survives one-shot mechanics the glass-cannon set doesn't
The most stagger damage a Sorcerer can bring
Nothing on the ground to waste when the boss moves
cons: Loses the two field Stigmas, about a quarter of the main build's damage on a dummy (Metaroad's TW parse: Fire Wall 15%, Cold Storm 9%)
Divine Burst does little outside the stagger window

builds.disagree: shr1kn drops both fields for Steel Barrier and Divine Burst. EUTOPIA and Metaroad swap only one Stigma: Cold Storm out for Steel Barrier in hard content, or Divine Burst in on stagger checks while Fire Wall stays. Games.gg's defensive set takes Arctic Armor instead of Divine Burst. On Divine Burst itself, aLuckyRO calls it pointless in PvE, and EUTOPIA says he has never failed a stagger check at 1,400–1,600 content. This build follows shr1kn's preset for the hardest bosses. If you only need one fix, swap one Stigma. The passive and point changes (Robe of Cold, Revitalization Contract) come from EUTOPIA's and shr1kn's passive levels, not from a published point order.
